basics.name: Cecilia A. Callejas
basics.label: Biomedical Engineer
basics.summary: PhD in Biomedical Engineering specializing in AI-driven medical technologies, algorithm design, signal processing, and machine learning for clinical applications

work.name: Tokyo University
work.summary: Conducting data science and AI research on healthy longevity, sleep epidemiology, and metabolic syndrome prevention, analyzing biodata, wearable-device data, and digital lifestyle data to identify health-risk patterns and support personalized feedback.

work.name: Chungnam National University Hospital
work.summary: Leading research on LLM–driven tools for CKD and AKI management, developing models that interpret clinical text and structured data to flag high-risk patients, support individualized treatment decisions, and reduce progression to kidney failure.
highlights: LLM-driven tools for CKD and AKI management

work.name: Seoul National University Hospital & Chungnam National University
work.summary: Leading research and development of AI-driven medical technologies, focusing on algorithm design, signal processing, and machine learning for clinical applications. Proficient in Python, MATLAB, Java, and Flutter for cross-platform medical software development. Combining expertise in computer vision and predictive modeling with hardware integration through embedded systems. Specializing in biomedical signal processing and developing practical AI-based tools.

work.name: MedInTech Inc.
work.summary: Developed a web server for monitoring in-house GPU status, designed and implemented the MedInTech Gateway software for endoscopic video capture, and engineered the MD-SC-300, an AI-powered cancer classification system for endoscopic devices. Demonstrated strong technical capabilities and made significant contributions to the company's R&D initiatives.

work.name: Chungnam National University
work.summary: Designed, developed, tested, and debugged hardware and software for medical devices, including firmware implementation and application development with database integration. Utilized Python, Java, and MATLAB across various development environments. Employed OrCad, PADs, and SolidWorks for hardware design, and developed firmware using Segger Embedded Studio and CubeMX. Applied AI techniques for medical data processing and analysis.

work.name: Daewoong Foundation
work.summary: Developed comprehensive pharmaceutical intelligence solutions, including a multilingual medical document translation platform Korean-English powered by LLM models and data-driven trend analysis systems. Created web-based applications with REST API integration and intuitive Streamlit interfaces. Implemented automated article crawling systems to track industry developments and monitor drug pipeline data, enhancing pharmaceutical market intelligence capabilities.

work.name: IDETECA S.R.L.
work.position: Head of Biomedicine and Chemical Department
work.summary: Evaluated, tested, and troubleshot software and hardware components for biomedical and electronic devices, working with various sensor technologies and measurement instruments.

work.name: Bolivian Catholic University
work.summary: Served as part-time professor teaching Electromagnetism and Calculus 1 courses.

work.name: IMEXCOMED S.R.L.
work.summary: Performed preventive and corrective maintenance of medical equipment, primarily endoscopic and surgical devices. Provided expert installation services and advanced software support in hospital environments.
